Confirmatory read (reconciled-scope step 5): dbca-97ac-ad96-4d6d ALREADY landed the observable proof this ticket asked for. tests/interfaces/contracts/test_workflow_error_codes_dbca.py asserts THROUGH the real render_workflow MCP read tool (via _mcp_envelope_for):
- render_workflow unknown name -> env["error"] == "not_found" and != "llm_unavailable" (test_render_workflow_unknown_name_is_not_found)
- render_workflow malformed/found file -> env["error"] == "invalid_input" and != "llm_unavailable" (test_render_workflow_malformed_is_invalid_input)
- get_workflow_status unknown/absent run -> "not_found"
- bare WorkflowError execute base + genuine outage -> still "llm_unavailable"

This is exactly 7d47's observable requirement (render_workflow WorkflowError family no longer surfaces as llm_unavailable), realized at the FINER, strictly-better reconciled codes (not_found/invalid_input) instead of the original brief's broad command_failed. Per the operator-approved reconciliation we do NOT re-assert command_failed for the WorkflowError family. No new code or test is warranted — the coverage exists and is landed on origin/main.

Disposition: SUPERSEDED by dbca-97ac-ad96-4d6d (linked duplicates). Closing.
